jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Program Lead Finance (f/m/d), you lead the Finance transformation for Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) while serving as co-lead of the overall LSS rollout within Siemens Energy's global S4Energy program.
In this project-driven Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business, you act as the key Finance & Controlling representative, ensuring that business requirements are translated into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions. Working closely with Finance, Controlling, Manufacturing, and global program teams, you steer critical decisions across project controlling, product costing, manufacturing controlling, and financial closing.
From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives
* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare
* Harmonize Finance & Controlling processes by balancing business requirements with SAP S/4HANA standards and scalable best practices
* Coordinate cross-functional rollout activities and manage dependencies across Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT
* Build and leverage a global Siemens Energy transformation network to share best practices and accelerate implementation success
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoption

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
* Extensive experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling, including leading complex implementation and business transformation programs
* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing
* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing
* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams
* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environment

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Process Operator (f/m/d)

Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, Germany
Start date: ASAP
Contract type: Full-time

About us

We’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.

Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.

Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.

The role

In this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.

The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production. Working hours are initially within typical daytime working hours; as production scales, openness to late and occasional weekend shifts is valued.

Your main tasks

- Preparation of fermentation media (weighing, mixing, heating, handling raw materials)
- Operating fermentation tanks and auxiliary equipment
- Supporting downstream processing (emptying tanks, handling and processing biomass)
- Operating our food processing line and its associated equipment
- Monitoring basic process parameters (e.g. temperature, time, filling levels)
- Cleaning and sanitising equipment (CIP systems and manual cleaning)
- Maintaining cleanliness, order, and safety in the facility
- Documenting basic production activities and flagging issues when they arise

Your profile

- Practical experience in food & beverage or similar manufacturing environments
- Comfortable working in a production setting with physical tasks and machinery
- Careful, reliable, and quality-oriented working style
- Interest in food production and fermentation processes
- Ability to work well in a small team and communicate clearly on the shop floor
- Basic working knowledge of English

Nice to have

- Experience in a brewery, dairy or fermentation-based production
- Technical or vocational training in a relevant field
- Familiarity with hygiene standards and food safety practices
- Experience with CIP systems or industrial cleaning routines
- Basic working knowledge of German

What we offer

- A full-time role with clear responsibilities and growth opportunities
- 28 days of paid holiday per year
- Subsidy for the Germany Ticket (“Deutschland-Ticket”)
- Hands-on training and close collaboration with experienced colleagues

How to apply

A short CV/brief overview of your previous work experience is sufficient.

We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/x) Biology (Life Sciences) for Preclinical Imaging

Radiochemie TV-L: 38,5 h/week (100%) 1-year fixed-term contract under the WissZeitVG; plus a 1-year extension for a third-party funded project
Your salary will be based on TV-L

Your tasks
• Planning, conducting and analyzing the biological evaluation of newly developed PET and SPECT radiotracers
• Contributing to the establishment, optimization and
documentation of biological test systems and preclinical evaluation protocols
• Performing in vitro studies, including stability, binding and cellular uptake assays as well as studies using models of the blood-brain-barrier
• Preclinical evaluation of tracer candidates in suitable in vivo models, including support of small-animal imaging studies
• Performing and analyzing ex vivo studies, e.g., autoradiography, biodistribution studies and complementary tissue analyses
• Quantitative analysis of biological and imaging data and
interpretation of results in close interaction with the other project partners
• Evaluation, documentation, and scientific presentation of experimental results in project reports, publications, and presentations

Your profile
• Completed university degree and Ph.D. in biology, life sciences, neuroscience, biochemistry, pharmacy or a related field
• Experience in preclinical imaging (e.g. small animal PET, SPECT, MRI, CT)
• Experience with animal models and experimental animal work is advantageous (FELASA-B or EU functions A, C, D)
• Experience with cell culture, in vitro assays, autoradiography, ex vivo analyses and BBB models is desirable
• Interest in radiopharmaceutical tracer development, molecular imaging and translational research
• Willingness to work with unsealed radioactive substances and to become familiar with radiation protection-related workflows
• Willingness to conduct biological and preclinical experiments within an interdisciplinary team
• Good written and spoken English skills
• Structured, independent and conscientious working style
• Ability to work in a team, strong communication skills and interest in interdisciplinary collaboration between chemistry, radiochemistry, biology, medicine and imaging

Our offer
• Everything but ordinary: You can expect a secure job in a challenging, innovative environment – including company pension schemes and regular working hours without business trips.
• Work-life balance: Whether full-time or part-time, with or without children – with numerous support options, we will find the right path together.
• Team spirit in R(h)ine culture: You will be warmly welcomed by an interdisciplinary team that values mutual respect and helpfulness.
• Strong perspectives: We offer extensive training opportunities – so you can continuously grow and set new goals.

Your future with us
We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail
The Institute of Radiochemistry and Experimental Molecular Imaging (IREMB) is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a translational research project in the field of radiopharmaceutical tracer development and molecular imaging. The postdoc position will initially be embedded for one year in the internationally funded IMAGESTRO project. There is an option of extension for another year. The focus of the work will be on the biological validation of newly developed PET or SPECT radiotracers.
The IMAGESTRO project aims to develop novel 18F-labeled PET tracers for the non-invasive imaging of estrogen receptors in the brain, to characterize them preclinically, and to translate them into human applications. The project focuses on the organic synthesis of suitable precursor and reference compounds, the development and optimization
of radiofluorination strategies, and the comprehensive analytical and preclinical characterization of the resulting radiotracers. The work will be carried out in close cooperation between the University Hospital Cologne and Forschungszentrum Jülich and offers an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of organic chemistry, radiochemistry, radiopharmacy, molecular imaging, biology and neuroscience.

Applications from female candidates are expressly welcome and will be given priority in the event of equal suitability, competence and professional performance. People with disabilities are welcome to apply and will be treated preferentially in the event of equal suitability and qualification. The position is suitable for staffing with part-time employees.

We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible:
Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/x) – Computational Modelling for Digital Mental Health and Psychiatry

Klinik für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie
TV-L: 38,5 h/week (100%)
limited for 5 years according to WissZeitVG within the framework of a third-party funded project
Your salary will be based on TV-L

Your tasks

• Develop and evaluate generative models for longitudinal digital phenotyping data
• Build and refine a simulation framework for synthetic patient trajectories
• Design and analyse virtual perturbation scenarios to investigate resilience and transition dynamics
• Develop and validate resilience metrics and approaches for transition typing
• Contribute to the implementation of a research prototype and reusable open resources
• Work closely with clinical and methodological collaborators within and beyond the University of Cologne
• Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, documentation, and open-science activities
• Support the supervision of junior researchers and contribute to the development of the research group

Your profile

• PhD in computational psychiatry, data science, computer science, statistics, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical informatics, or a related field
• Strong expertise in at least some of the following areas: machine learning, deep learning, generative modelling, time-series modelling, probabilistic modelling, or simulation
• Very good programming skills, ideally in Python and relevant ML frameworks such as PyTorch
• Experience working with longitudinal, multivariate behavioural data
• Strong interest in mental health research and interdisciplinary collaboration with clinical partners
• A structured, independent, and reliable way of working combined with strong team skills
• Very good written and spoken English; German is welcome but not required
• A solid publication record appropriate to career stage is desirable

Our offer

• Everything but ordinary: You can expect a secure job in a challenging, innovative environment – including company pension schemes and regular working hours without business trips.
• Team spirit in R(h)ine culture: You will be warmly welcomed by an interdisciplinary team that values mutual respect and helpfulness.
• Strong perspectives: We offer extensive training opportunities – so you can continuously grow and set new goals.

Your future with us

We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail

We are looking to support a newly established research group as soon as possible.
The position is embedded in the third-party funded research project SiReD-MH (Tipping Minds: Simulation of Resilience Dynamics in Mental Health). The project develops a hybrid in-silico framework to model resilience dynamics and transitions into mental illness in young people at risk. Using longitudinal digital phenotyping data, including ecological momentary assessment, actigraphy, and GPS-derived mobility measures, the project combines generative machine learning and simulation to build synthetic patient trajectories and test resilience under virtual perturbation scenarios.
The postdoctoral researcher will play a central role in shaping the methodological core of the project and in helping build a new interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of psychiatry, machine learning, dynamic systems theory, and simulation.

Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About the opportunity

As (Senior) Manager Direct Tax Compliance & Processes, you will act as a trusted business partner to management, driving efficiency and effectiveness across tax compliance, accounting, and reporting activities. You will play a key role in enhancing QIAGEN's tax compliance and governance framework, supporting our tax compliance insourcing strategy, and advancing tax quality and change management initiatives. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders while contributing to tax reporting, compliance, process optimization, and strategic tax projects across the DACH region.

* Further develop and enhance the Tax Compliance Management System while proactively supporting tax governance, tax quality, and change management initiatives.
* Support annual tax reporting at both legal entity and group level, including the calculation of tax positions and preparation of tax-related disclosures under US GAAP and local GAAP requirements.
* Manage direct tax return and compliance processes in collaboration with external advisors across the DACH region.
* Oversee additional tax compliance obligations within the DACH region and maintain the tax compliance calendar.
* Manage inbound and outbound withholding tax matters, including reporting and filing requirements, while identifying and implementing process improvements.
* Serve as a key business partner for Accounting, Treasury, Legal, Operations, and other internal stakeholders on tax-related matters.
* Support tax audits, tax planning activities, and corporate tax restructuring projects.

Your profile
* University degree in Business Administration, Economics (with a focus on Tax and/or Accounting), Tax Administration (Finanzwirt) or a comparable qualification.
* At least 5 years of relevant professional experience gained within an international advisory firm (e.g., Big 4) and/or the tax function of a multinational organization.
* Strong understanding of direct tax compliance, tax accounting, and tax reporting requirements.
* Proven ability to work independently with a high level of accuracy, diligence, and quality awareness.
* Experience with Microsoft Office applications as well as tax and ERP systems such as DATEV and SAP.
* Professional proficiency in English and German with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative team player with strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

jobs.description:
The University Medical Center Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH) combines world-class international research with interdisciplinary patient care. We are the state's only comprehensive care provider and its largest employer. Our approximately 17,500 employees ensure highly personalized care—which is indispensable for the people of Schleswig-Holstein.
The University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH) with its locations in Kiel and Lübeck is one of the largest medical care centers in Europe. It serves to warrant maximum medical care in the northernmost federal state and guarantees medical-technical care at the highest level, especially for patients who require highly differentiated diagnosis and therapy. The unique feature of university medicine is the interaction of health care, research and teaching with the result that scientific findings flow directly into the health system.

Our research aims to develop novel diagnostic and therapeutic strategies for chronic inflammatory diseases, including inflammatory bowel, liver, lung and skin diseases. To achieve this, we investigate the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying immune regulation in different disease contexts and employ state-of-the-art technologies to comprehensively characterize human immune cells, with a particular focus on antigen-specific CD4+ T cells. A major focus of our research is the integration of high-dimensional single-cell and immune repertoire data. Our group combines enrichment of rare antigen-specific CD4+ T cells with multidimensional flow cytometry, single-cell RNA sequencing, T cell receptor sequencing and ATAC sequencing to investigate cellular states, immune cell differentiation, clonality and regulatory mechanisms in health and disease.

As a PhD student / postdoctoral researcher in bioinformatics, you will be an integral part of the research activities within our group. You will develop and pursue independent research projects and also contribute to a broad range of collaborative projects involving different members of the group. Your work will focus on the computational analysis, integration and interpretation of high-dimensional sequencing data, with particular emphasis on:

- Analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing, T cell receptor sequencing, and ATAC sequencing data
- Integration of transcriptomic, TCR, epigenetic and flow cytometry data to characterize immune cell states and regulatory mechanisms
- Development and application of reproducible bioinformatics workflows and analysis pipelines, including data visualization and interpretation
- Active contribution to diverse collaborative projects within the group, including the planning and design of computational analyses in close interaction with experimental scientists

Start in our team:
Join our research team starting from February 1st 2027. The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extension. We are looking forward to welcoming you as part of our team with all your skills and commitment.

What we offer:

- Salary will be according to the German salary scale TV-L (German TV-L E13, PhD student 65%, Postdoc 100%)
- A full-time position, currently 38,5 hours/week; part-time employment may be compatible within the framework of certain working time models
- Exceptional technical infrastructure especially for multi-dimensional flow-cytometry and for next generation sequencing at the the Institute of Medical Immunology and the Center of Molecular Biosciences (ZMB)
- You can find more exciting benefits offered by the UKSH here:Benefits (uksh.de)

What you can expect:

- A fascinating research environment for the investigation of basic processes of human immune reactions with direct implications for immune-mediated diseases
- A systematic training to work independently in a challenging and diversified research field
- The opportunity to work in a dedicated, supportive and international research team
- An extensive pool of sophisticated methods and complex laboratory instruments

Whatyou bring with you:
University degree (Master's or equivalent) in bioinformatics, computational biology, biology, biostatistics, data science or a related field; completed PhD required for postdoctoral positions

Strong interest in single-cell omics, immunology and computational analysis of biological data

Experience with next-generation sequencing technologies (e.g. scRNA-seq, TCR-seq or ATAC-seq) is desirable

Good programming skills in R and/or Python, including the development, adaptation and documentation of computational workflows

High degree of commitment, independence, organizational skills and responsibility, along with strong communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively with experimental and clinical teams

We look forward to receiving your application (CV, motivation letter stating research and career interests, copies of education certificates, and two letters of recommendation) by 29.10.2026; please include job posting number 29445.

jobs.description:
Shape compliance. Drive governance. Protect global business.
 

At DHL Group, we connect people and improve lives through our global logistics network. Behind our world-leading operations stands a strong commitment to governance, compliance, and risk management. We are looking for an experienced Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) to play a pivotal role in ensuring that our insurance activities remain compliant, transparent, and future-ready. This position combines insurance taxation, regulatory compliance, governance, and stakeholder management in a highly international environment.
 

Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d)
   

Why experienced insurance professionals join this role
* Move from advising to owning insurance governance decisions.
* Shape multinational insurance programs across a global organization.
* Influence strategic decisions involving Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, and Risk Management.
* Work at the intersection of insurance, regulation, governance, and business strategy.
* Gain exposure to some of the most complex international insurance arrangements in the market.

 

You'll make an impact by:
* Defining and evolving DHL Group's global insurance governance framework.
* Ensuring regulatory excellence across international insurance programs.
* Leading complex tax, regulatory, and compliance initiatives.
* Managing interactions with authorities, regulators, auditors, brokers, and insurers.
* Providing strategic guidance on multinational insurance structures and cross-border risk solutions.

 

What You Will Do:

Insurance Tax & Compliance
* Serve as the central expert for insurance premium tax matters in Germany.
* Advise business stakeholders on insurance taxation, insurance distribution compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Assess domestic and international insurance programs, including multinational insurance structures, global master policies, local policies, captive insurance arrangements, and Freedom of Services (FOS) solutions.
* Review and evaluate insurance premium tax treatment for insurance contracts and insurance-related services.
* Support the design, implementation, and launch of new insurance programs while ensuring tax and regulatory compliance. Governance & Risk Management

* Maintain and continuously improve insurance tax governance and compliance frameworks.
* Design and oversee internal control systems for insurance premium tax processes.
* Contribute to the enhancement of DHL Group's Tax Compliance Management System.
* Conduct risk assessments and compliance reviews related to insurance distribution and taxation.
* Promote transparency, documentation standards, and audit readiness across the organization. 

 

Regulatory & Audit Management
* Manage insurance premium tax audits and regulatory reviews independently.
* Act as the primary contact for tax authorities, auditors, legal advisors, insurers, and brokers.
* Develop strategies to address audit findings and mitigate regulatory risks.
* Monitor developments in German and international insurance tax legislation and relevant court decisions.
* Ensure regulatory awareness and compliance regarding insurance distribution activities in Germany.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with colleagues from Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, Risk Management, and other business functions.
* Support DHL business units in understanding and meeting insurance compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with external advisors, brokers, insurers, and regulatory stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.

 

What You Bring
* University degree in Law, Tax, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field.
* Several years of professional experience in insurance taxation, insurance regulation, compliance, risk management, legal, or related disciplines.
* Proven expertise in German Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) regulations and insurance compliance requirements.
* Experience managing regulatory inquiries, audits, disputes, and complex multinational insurance programs.
* Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, including Property, Liability, Marine, Cargo, Cyber, D&O, Financial Lines, and Employee Benefits.
* Experience developing governance, control, and compliance frameworks in international organizations.
* Excellent English language skills and good German language proficiency.

 

Who You Are

You are a strategic and analytical professional who enjoys navigating complex regulatory environments. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable advising senior decision-makers. You thrive in international settings, communicate effectively, and maintain the highest standards of integrity and quality.
 

What We Offer
* A highly visible role with global impact across one of the world's leading logistics companies.
* Exposure to complex international insurance, tax, and compliance topics.
* Opportunities to collaborate with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.
* A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.
* Continuous professional development and career growth opportunities within DHL Group.(Employer value proposition formulated based on the role's global scope and responsibilities.)

 

Why DHL Group?

At DHL Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and grow. We value diverse perspectives and believe that our people are the key to our success. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and performance.
 

Your benefits
 
* Well-Being: Fun, team spirit, and health are crucial factors. Therefore, within the company, we offer a wide range of health and preventive care services, an occupational physician
* Family-friendly: The compatibility of family and work has many facets, such as childcare, care for family members, etc. We support this, for example, through kindergarten places as well as the Betreuungs- und Erholungswerk (support and recreation program).
* Employee Share Program: As an employee, you have the opportunity to participate in DHL Group's employee share program and share directly in the company's long-term success.
* Mobility: We move not only letters or parcels but also our employees through offerings such as company bicycles, job tickets and possibly company cars.
* Location: The Post Campus brings together people from more than 60 countries. The Post Tower is easily accessible by car, public transportation and bicycle. To facilitate the workday, the campus offers amenities such as parking spaces, post office, café, canteen and more.
* Onboarding: Individual onboarding, training on the job, networking, a dedicated certified program, etc., lay the foundation for a successful start at DHL Group.
* Development opportunities: We offer numerous development opportunities through a comprehensive training landscape, junior talent programs, coaching etc.
* Social commitment: Through global corporate programs, we improve the educational and career opportunities for young people and engage in disaster management at airports. We also contribute to local environmental protection and aid projects initiated by employees on a voluntary basis.
* What else? Company pension plan, social counseling, inclusion consulting, cleaning service, insurance cooperation, corporate discounts, events, sabbaticals and much more!

 

About DHL Group

DHL Group is the world’s leading logistics company, connecting people and businesses in more than 220 countries and territories through a comprehensive portfolio of logistics, e-commerce, parcel, express, freight forwarding, and supply chain management services.

With approximately 580,000 employees worldwide, DHL Group operates one of the largest global logistics networks.

Our purpose is simple: Connecting People. Improving Lives.
 

Apply now with your complete documents, stating your salary expectations, using the application button.
 

For further information, please visit careers.dhl.com. For initial personal contact and any questions, please contact Sven Rötzel at sven.roetzel@dhl.com or 0228-189-52128.
 

We look forward to receiving your application*.

CONNECTING PEOPLE. IMPROVING LIVES.
 

*At DHL Group, applications from all individuals are welcome, regardless of age, gender, origin, religion or physical attributes.

Who We Are 🌍

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do 🔧

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

- Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
- Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
- **Make throughput a design decision:**Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.
- **Ship modules, not scripts:**Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.
- Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.

What You Bring 🕵️

- Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.
- Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
- Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
- Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
- Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica 🚀

- Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
- Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
- Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
- Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
- Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.
